findings.source_quote: διὰ τοῦτο τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῶν ξηρά ἐστι καὶ δύναμιν μὴ ἔχοντα
findings.english_quote: Their foundations are dry and powerless.
findings.issue: The explicit causal connection, “because of this,” is omitted. The source explains that the preceding divided allegiance and lip/heart discrepancy account for the dry, powerless foundations; the simplified edition presents only the resulting condition.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “That is why their foundations are dry and powerless.”

findings.source_quote: οὕτω καὶ οἱ δίψυχοι, ὅταν θλῖψιν ἀκούσωσι, διὰ τὴν δειλίαν αὐτῶν εἰδωλολατροῦσι καὶ τὸ ὄνομα ἐπαισχύνονται τοῦ Κυρίου αὐτῶν.
findings.english_quote: In the same way, people of divided allegiance hear of persecution. Out of cowardice, they worship idols and are ashamed of their Lord’s name.
findings.issue: Separating “hear of persecution” into an independent assertion drops the explicit temporal circumstance introduced by ὅταν: their idol worship and shame occur when they hear of persecution. The analogy retains cowardice as the cause but no longer explicitly preserves hearing of persecution as the occasion.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “In the same way, when people of divided allegiance hear of persecution, they worship idols out of cowardice and are ashamed of their Lord’s name.”

summary: The standard edition faithfully represents the selected working Greek throughout. The simplified edition preserves the principal assertions, negations, repentance conditions, and imagery, but needs two connective relationships restored. Both editions disclose the editorial supplements and adverse alternative in paragraph 4 consistently with the supplied project reports; those alternatives do not require replacing the selected working reading. Acceptance here concerns the supplied text and disclosures, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, independent verification of editions, or exhaustive collation. Proposed corrections require fresh review.
